correctness.rationale: Poisson summation gives e=A_h−T_hm. The tail T is 1/h periodic; cover [-1,1]^d by 2^d unit cubes (h≤1), each contained in one full period after shifting, and apply Parseval: ∫|T|²≤2^d h^d sum_{j∉[-m,m]^d}|khat(hj)|². The difference density v=ρ*ρ̌ is supported in [-1,1]^d and bounded by R. The Matérn spectral envelope and BGR half-space lattice bound at power 4ν+2d yield RMS tail C_(d,ν)sqrt R ell^(-2ν)(hm)^(-2ν-d/2). Include uniform alias a_h by L² triangle inequality. N diagonal entries carry deterministic e(0), the offdiagonals have q², giving exact Frobenius second moment; bounded differences 2M²/N for U-statistic give exp(−Ns²/(2M⁴)), and Borel–Cantelli gives fixed-parameter a.s. convergence. Independently checked spectral normalization/envelopes on 72 scalar cases and finite Parseval examples; analytic proof gives arbitrary d.
residual_risks: Alias contribution a_h must also shrink for total approximation rate; no claim of alias-free bound.
Density only bounded; no uniform triangular-array result as N,h,m vary.
